title: Harden config diagnostics status evidence
summary: Fail closed on submitted unknown settings keys, cap status/event tail reads by bytes, and avoid blocked diagnostics posture for negated error phrases.
reason: The review found release risks where settings patches could introduce unregistered keys, status readers could read unbounded oversized tails, and diagnostics fallback scanners could treat successful 'without errors' text as blocked evidence.
behavior_before: Settings preview/save accepted patch-submitted unknown keys as warning-only evidence, status tail readers were line-bounded but not byte-bounded, and diagnostics tail evidence used raw substring matching for error terms.
behavior_after: Settings preview/save reject patch-submitted unknown keys while preserving untouched legacy unknown keys, status and event tails stop at a byte cap, and diagnostics/WebView tail classification ignores obvious negated success phrases while still blocking true error terms.
